title: Unique Uruguayan Sushi Rice Bowl
description: A flexitarian friendly dish featuring sushi rice, served in a lacquerware bowl, with earthy and crisp flavors, inspired by Uruguayan cuisine.
instructions: Rinse the sushi rice thoroughly and cook it according to the package instructions with 2 1/4 cups of water.
In a small saucepan, combine the rice vinegar and 1 tablespoon of water, and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the vinegar mixture for 5 minutes.
Prepare the grilled portobello mushrooms by brushing them with oil and seasoning with salt.
Grill the mushrooms over medium heat for 3-4 minutes per side, until tender.
Prepare the roasted butternut squash by tossing it with oil, salt, and sesame seeds, and roasting it in the oven at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 20 minutes.
Prepare the pickled red onion by soaking it in a mixture of vinegar and water for at least 30 minutes.
To assemble the bowls, divide the cooked sushi rice among four lacquerware bowls.
Top the rice with the grilled mushrooms, roasted squash, pickled onion, and toasted pumpkin seeds.
Drizzle the chimichurri sauce over the top of each bowl and serve immediately.
